info.title: JioEvents Platform APIs
info.description: This section covers the JioEvents Platform APIs which can be used to quickly setup JioEvents APIs in your backend for event management and virtual event hosting.

post.summary: Meeting Invite - Create a meeting invite
post.description: This API creates a meeting invite for a participant to join a scheduled webinar or meeting

parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.description: The content type should be application/json

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: You need an app created on the JioEvents Platform and using the app credentials you can create a JWT to access this API. The JWT should have an issuer and the key "app" with the app id generated from the Platform.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: The accept type should be application/json

identity.description: Email address or identity of the invitee

sendInvite.description: Whether to send an email invite to the participant

meetingId.description: The meeting ID for which the invite is being created

_id.description: Unique identifier for the meeting invite

joinUrl.description: The URL that the invitee can use to join the meeting

joinHash.description: Unique hash for joining the meeting

role.description: The role assigned to the invitee

meetingId.description: The meeting ID for which the invite was created

isDeleted.description: Whether the invite has been deleted

socialMediaLinks.description: Array of social media links associated with the invitee

isInviteSent.description: Whether the invite has been sent

sendInvite.description: Whether to send an email invite

enableSpeakerTile.description: Whether to enable speaker tile for this participant

message.description: The error code of the API
